Oh? I see that you're an adventurer.\nHow rare to see someone traveling alone around\nhere...
Hm? Me? I'm Tenert.\nThe leader of Support Caravan for Adventurers.
...So, you're lost. Alright, I'll have one of\nour guys guide you to the city. Don't mention it.\nWe're here to provide support for adventurers.
...Huh? What, you don't know who we are?\nGosh, I thought everyone knew who we were.\nMaybe you're a rookie adventurer, aren't you?
You're right...
I just started!
I'm not a rookie.
Just now?! Ha ha! I got it!\nNo wonder you seemed so out of place.
...Oh, my bad. Don't look so upset.\nIt was only an honest mistake.
Good, then.\nHere, let me interest you with something.
You see, we just finished building this camp here.\nIt's totally up to you, but you can learn some\nuseful information for your adventure.
Our organization is dedicated to supporting new\nadventures like you so that you won't end up\ndead on the ground. Care to spend some time here?
Sure, thanks!
Well, I'm not so sure...
Oh, a new member? Hm... You look kinda cute.\nI'm Libera. I'm in charge of item management.\nHow is it going?
Unfortunately, this is an adventurer.\nI was just asking if the adventurer wants to take\nsome tutorials or not. So, what was your answer?
You can get [64ffff]lots of useful items[ffffff] if you take the\ntutorials, so what's there to lose?\n...I could personally teach you if you like.
Alright, then I'll go ahead and get prepared.\nI'll be straight down that way.\nSee you later.
Some members are staying at the camp.\n[64ffff]Go talk to them and they'll give you some items[ffffff].
...Hm?\nWhy, you ask?
Well that's...
That's because it's our job!
Let's talk to the members in the camp and\ngo to see Tenert the leader.
Cannot go to another map now.
Oh! You must be the new adventurer!\nWelcome to our camp!\nWe're Support Caravan for Adventurers!
I am aware that you will be receiving training\nfrom Tenert, our leader!\nHere, please make good use of these supplies!
[Regera] heals your wounds over time!\nIt doesn't have immediate effect, so please use it\nbefore you're in a critical state!
Have you talked to the other members? They'll\nprovide you with useful items for your adventure,\nso I recommend that you go talk to all of them.
I'm afraid that your bag is full!\nCould you make some extra space in there?
Ah, welcome, adventurer... Huh? No, I'm fine.\nI'm just a bit tired right now...\nYes, I've heard about you.
I was ordered to give these to you...\nHere, please take them.\nI'm sure they'll come in handy.
[Vita Plus] increases MaxHP for a limited time.\nI suggest you take it prior to taking on a strong\nenemy.
The worst-case scenario would be for you to lose\nall your HP, so please be aware of your current\nHP at all times.
We have three types of supplies.\nPlease go to see Tenert the leader when you have\nreceived them all.
Seems like your bag is full.\nMaybe you should reduce your inventory...
Hey there! You must be the new adventurer.\nWelcome to our camp!
You're gonna go see Tenert, right?\nThen, take this with you.\nUse it wisely, okay?
[Revita] is a medicine that heals your HP.\nUse it when you've taken damage from monsters.
When your HP reaches 0, you're all done for.\nSo, make sure you pay attention to your HP at all\ntimes.
D'you get all three supplies?\nGo see Tenert when you've got them all.
Hey, don't be so greedy. Your bag is full.\nGet rid of some of your inventory.
The members in the camp will give you items when\nyou talk to them. Do you want to proceed without\nreceiving all the items?
Proceed
Go back
Alright, let's get started. Going on adventures\nmeans that you encounter battles with monsters.\nAt least, you need to know the basics to survive.
Hey, I've got a spare minute to teach you if you\nwant... Do you want me or the leader to train you?
Who do you want to learn from?
Tenert
Libera
